Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration

Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

jobs.location: New York, New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.

Department: Support Operations

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
  • Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

  • Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
  • Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
  • Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
  • Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets

  • Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
  • Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow

Data, Reporting & Accountability

  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling

  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization

Work Environment

Benefits

About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

jobs.description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

jobs.title: Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your Role & How we work

As our Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d), you build and run the internal data products that our investment team, Quantitative Research and AI Engineering rely on every day: the pipelines, datasets, APIs and tools that turn a large and growing pool of financial and alternative data into something investors can act on. Our stack is Python, SQL, AWS, and Databricks.

You report to our Director of Engineering. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes to designing, building, and shipping. The team is small, so you take ownership of real products early, and you get a manager and colleagues invested in your growth into investment and data-platform topics. You work closely with Quantitative Research, AI Engineering, Product & Data, and the investment team, and we treat agentic AI as a default in how we build.

What you will do

  • Build and improve the internal products the investment and research teams use daily: data pipelines, datasets, APIs, and tooling, on top of our lakehouse and orchestration stack.

  • Work directly with the teams you build for: take in their requests, triage and prioritise them, protect the integrity and consistency of the product, and explain features and implementation trade-offs in clear, non-technical language.

  • Design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines, ETLs and integrations that handle complex financial and alternative datasets.

  • Bring and reinforce good engineering habits in the team: automated testing at several levels, CI/CD, pull requests and code review, and clear documentation.

  • Contribute to operational excellence: observability, monitoring, data quality, and secure data handling.

  • Use agentic AI across engineering work (coding, review, testing, debugging, documentation) and help the team push these practices forward.


The experience you bring

  • 3 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience, building and operating systems in production.

  • Strong Python and strong SQL, with clean, readable code and a good sense for data modelling.

  • Proven engineering discipline: you write tests (unit, integration, data quality), work with CI/CD, and use pull requests and code review as a matter of course, and you can show how you helped a team adopt them.

  • Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain what you built, why, and what it will and will not do, and you can say no constructively.

  • Hands-on use of AI across engineering functions, including frontier coding systems such as Claude Code and Codex, as a core part of how you work.

  • Genuine interest in investing, financial markets and data, and the ambition to grow into these topics.

  • Nice to have: Databricks or PySpark; data platform tooling such as orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar), lakehouse formats (Parquet, Delta, Iceberg) and AWS; experience with investment, financial or market data; building web frontends or APIs for internal tools; LLM systems in production.

Du willst Finanzberatung nicht aus dem Lehrbuch lernen, sondern dort, wo sie passiert? Bei Old Fox Finance steigst du in die ganzheitliche Finanz- und Versicherungsberatung ein. Vom ersten Tag an begleitest du erfahrene Berater bei echten Kundenterminen, meist online und siehst live, wie aus Zahlen ein Finanzkonzept wird, das zum Leben eines Menschen passt.

Du arbeitest selbstständig, aber nicht allein: Erfahrene Partner stehen dir zur Seite und die Abwicklung von Anträgen und Verträgen läuft über einen Maklerpool. Um IT und Papierkram musst du dich nicht kümmern. Produkt- und Absatzvorgaben gibt es keine.

Aufgaben

  • Von Anfang an mittendrin: Du begleitest erfahrene Berater bei Kundenterminen und lernst Gesprächsführung, Bedarfsanalyse und Finanzplanung in der Praxis.

  • Dein eigener Kundenkreis: Schritt für Schritt baust du dir eigene Kunden auf.

  • Selbst beraten: Mit der IHK-Sachkundeprüfung und eigener Erlaubnis berätst du deine Kunden später selbst, zu Absicherung, Altersvorsorge, Vermögensaufbau und Finanzierung.

  • Dein Rhythmus: Wann und wo du arbeitest, entscheidest du selbst.Qualifikation

Qualifikation

  • Begeisterung für Finanzen und Vermögensaufbau, gern auch für deine eigenen

  • Freude an Gesprächen und der Wunsch, Menschen wirklich weiterzubringen

  • Eigenmotivation und Durchhaltevermögen: Du ziehst Dinge durch, auch wenn es mal zäh wird

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Von Vorteil: kaufmännische Ausbildung, Studium oder erste Erfahrung in Bank, Versicherung oder Vertrieb

  • Du erfüllst nicht alles, hast aber Lust auf die Herausforderung? Dann melde dich trotzdem.

Benefits

  • Echte Praxis statt Theorie: erfahrene Berater an deiner Seite, ab Tag eins

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Einstiegsschulungen, danach laufende Weiterbildung bis zur IHK-Sachkundeprüfung

  • Leistungsabhängige Vergütung ohne Obergrenze: Schon am Anfang verdienst du mit, wenn aus deinen Kontakten Kunden werden

  • Keine Einstiegsgebühr

Du arbeitest als selbstständiger Partner und wirst leistungsabhängig über Provision vergütet. Alle Details zu Vergütung und Einstieg legen wir dir im ersten Gespräch offen.

Klingt nach dir? Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht, ein paar Sätze zu dir reichen. Danach telefonieren wir zehn Minuten und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob es passt.

Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Do you get energy from winning new customers? Do you know how to build a pipeline from scratch, engage senior decision-makers and turn complex business challenges into successful deals?

At Yenlo, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just manage them.

This is a true hunting role, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on Yenlo's growth. We have built a strong international business in Integration, API Management, Identity & Access Management and Managed Services. Now we are expanding into Data, AI, Automation and Control. We have the technology expertise, strong partnerships and delivery capabilities. What we need is someone who can bring us to the right table, create demand and win new business.

About Yenlo

Yenlo has helped organisations connect their business-critical systems and processes for more than 17 years. We do this with around 100 colleagues from over 18 nationalities, with offices in the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Sri Lanka, the United States and Canada. We have been a WSO2 Platinum Partner since 2008 and a Boomi partner since 2015, and our customers include Boeing, Hard Rock Café and several ministries and universities. Now we are building on our integration expertise with Data, AI and Automation, so customers can bring their technology into production securely and reliably. For that, we are looking for someone who opens new markets.

What will you do?

As Enterprise Account Executive, your primary mission is to win new customers and build profitable, long-term business relationships.

You will focus on mid-market and enterprise organisations across the Benelux and DACH regions, particularly those facing complex challenges around applications, integration, data, cloud transformation and AI.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Win new logos and build your own pipeline. Identify target accounts, open doors and generate business through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic partnerships.

  • Engage senior decision-makers and sell business value. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs and other business and technology leaders, and translate their challenges into opportunities around Integration, Data, AI, Automation and Control.

  • Own the sales cycle. Lead opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation and closing, together with our solution architects, consultants and product specialists.

  • Help shape our go-to-market. Bring customer insights and market feedback into Yenlo to help us improve our propositions and commercial approach.

  • Deliver results. Take ownership of your pipeline, forecasts, new-business targets and the profitability of the deals you win.

You will have access to existing customer references, partner relationships and marketing support. But this is not a role where you inherit a ready-to-close pipeline or rely on an SDR team to fill your calendar. We expect you to create opportunities yourself and have the commercial drive to turn them into business.

What can you expect from Yenlo?

At Yenlo, you will join an international technology company with around 100 colleagues, strong technical expertise and ambitious plans for the future.

We offer:

  • Real ownership. A new-business role with the freedom to develop opportunities and make a visible commercial impact.

  • Attractive earning potential. A competitive fixed salary and a substantial performance-based bonus, with uncapped upside for overachievement.

  • A strong technology portfolio. Established capabilities in Integration, API Management, IAM and Managed Services, complemented by growing propositions in Data, AI and Control.

  • Access to specialists. Experienced solution architects, consultants and product teams to support discovery, demonstrations, assessments and proposals.

  • An international ecosystem. Partnerships with leading technology providers, including Boomi and WSO2, alongside Yenlo's own Connext platform.

  • Room to build. The opportunity to contribute to our evolving commercial approach, propositions and go-to-market strategy.

  • Professional benefits. Pension arrangements, holiday allowance, a lease car or mobility allowance, laptop and phone.

  • A realistic start. An appropriate ramp-up period, recognising that enterprise sales cycles take time and building a pipeline starts from day one.

You will work closely with our sales leadership and wider commercial organisation. We believe in face-to-face collaboration, both with customers and colleagues, and expect you to spend time at our Schiphol-Rijk office on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.


We are looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial sales professional with a proven track record in complex B2B technology sales.

You know how to build relationships, navigate enterprise organisations and close significant deals.

What you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of generating your own pipeline and personally closing new enterprise customers.

  • Experience selling complex IT services, software, cloud, integration or other enterprise technology solutions.

  • Experience managing six-figure deals and longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Strong outbound prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.

  • The ability to engage credibly with senior business and technology decision-makers.

  • Enough technical understanding to discuss Integration, APIs, Data and AI, while focusing on business outcomes rather than technical features.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to succeed without a fully established sales playbook.

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and commercial colleagues.

  • Professional proficiency in Dutch and English.

Experience with platforms such as Boomi, WSO2, MuleSoft, AWS, Azure or related enterprise technologies is an advantage, but not a requirement. An existing network in the Benelux or DACH enterprise market would be a strong plus. We care more about what you have personally achieved than the number of years on your CV or the technology companies you have worked for.

Ready to make an impact?

If you enjoy opening doors, creating opportunities and winning complex enterprise deals, we would love to meet you.

jobs.description:
Over ons
 
Steeds meer mensen in Europa kiezen ervoor om zelfstandig te werken als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Zelfstandig werken biedt vrijheid en flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer, hoe en met wie je wilt werken. Het zien groeien van je eigen bedrijf kan zowel professioneel als financieel belonend zijn.
 
Zelfstandig zijn brengt echter ook onzekerheden met zich mee. De juiste verzekeringen zijn essentieel om voorbereid te zijn op de risico’s van het ondernemerschap.
 
Bij Insify bieden we transparante, flexibele en eerlijk geprijsde verzekeringen, afgestemd op de behoeften van ondernemers. Zo kunnen zij zich volledig richten op hun werk, in de wetenschap dat ze altijd op ons kunnen rekenen.
Insify verzekert duizenden klanten in heel Europa. Wij bieden betrouwbare verzekeringen zonder ingewikkeld papierwerk. Een verzekering bij Insify sluit je 100% digitaal af, vandaag geregeld is morgen verzekerd.
 
Hoe wij werken
 
Bij Insify hebben we vier kernwaarden: doorzettingsvermogen, impact, zorg en ondernemerschap. Die leggen we kort even uit:
Doorzettingsvermogen: We zijn niet bang voor uitdagingen en gaan juist door waar anderen stoppen.
Impact: We maken het verschil in het leven van onze klanten en belonen hun vertrouwen in ons. 
Zorg: Wij stellen onze klanten altijd centraal. Hun succes is ons doel.
Ondernemerschap: Innovatie zit in ons DNA. We gaan snel en we denken groot.  
 
Bij Insify word je onderdeel van een hecht team. Daarom werken we het liefst zo veel mogelijk op kantoor. Dat klinkt misschien raar voor een 100% online verzekeraar, maar wij geloven dat een sterke onderlinge band ons helpt sneller te innoveren en onze klanten nog beter te bedienen. Zo’n band is eigenlijk alleen via persoonlijk contact te realiseren.
Door regelmatig naar kantoor te komen, leren nieuwe collega’s bovendien sneller en voelen ze zich eerder thuis.
 
We begrijpen ook dat je misschien niet elke dag naar kantoor kunt komen of dat er momenten zijn dat je je focus nodig hebt. Daarom is gedeeltelijk thuiswerken in overleg mogelijk.
 
Operations Team
 
Wij zijn degenen die vertrouwen opbouwen bij elk contactmoment—of het nu om een verkoop, een supportgesprek of het afhandelen van een claim gaat. We zorgen ervoor dat prospects en klanten zich gesteund, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Snelheid en kwaliteit zijn voor ons belangrijk, en we volgen onze voortgang nauwgezet zodat we blijven verbeteren. Met het oog op de toekomst bereiden we ons voor op medische acceptatie in 2025—een volgende stap om onze service nóg sterker te maken.

Jouw rol
 
Binnen Insify zijn we op zoek naar een ambitieuze werkstudent rechten die op zoek is naar een betekenisvolle bijbaan naast de studie. Een rol waarin juridische kennis direct wordt toegepast, klantcontact centraal staat en waardevolle ervaring wordt opgedaan die uitstekend aansluit bij een toekomstige juridische carrière.
 
Als werkstudent Claims & Legal Support ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten van Insify met een schade- of arbeidsongeschiktheidsclaim. Je combineert klantgerichtheid met juridische scherpte en zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten snel, eerlijk en zorgvuldig worden geholpen.
 
Je werkt nauw samen met onze Legal & Claims specialisten en denkt mee over complexe aansprakelijkheidskwesties en bezwaarprocedures. Jij zorgt dat onze belofte van snelle, heldere en menselijke service ook in de praktijk wordt waargemaakt.

Jouw profiel
  • Aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je helpt klanten die schade melden of arbeidsongeschikt zijn geraakt. Je luistert, stelt de juiste vragen en begeleidt hen door het proces.
  • Claims behandelen. Je beoordeelt claims inhoudelijk en zorgt voor een efficiënte en correcte afhandeling, met oog voor zowel klant als organisatie.
  • Meedenken in complexe dossiers. Je ondersteunt bij lastige casussen, bijvoorbeeld rond aansprakelijkheid of bij het opstellen van reacties op bezwaren.
  • Samenwerken met Legal. Je schakelt met het juridische team bij ingewikkelde vraagstukken en werkt mee aan het verder verbeteren van interne processen
  • Een tweede of derdejaars bachelorstudent of een masterstudent Verzekeringsrecht of Nederlands Recht heeft onze voorkeur. 
  • Goede beheersing van zowel de Engels als Nederlandse taal. 
  • Beschikbaar voor minimaal 2 of 3 dagen per week voor minimaal 6 maanden;

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to deliver end-to-end technical program execution across hardware, software, optics and manufacturing - setting the structure, aligning teams, and driving critical programs from R&D through to on-time mass manufactured product delivery.

As Technical Program Manager, you will run a number of programs critical to OLIX’s delivery. You’ll partner closely with engineering to set direction, identify blockers, implement risk mitigations and report on status. You’ll take ownership of cross-functional delivery within your programs, ensuring reliable, high-quality execution in areas critical to OLIX's roadmap.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs from initiation through to completion.

  • Define and maintain program plans, milestones, dependencies, and critical path across multiple workstreams.

  • Drive alignment between engineering, product, and business stakeholders on scope, priorities, and trade-offs.

  • Broad engineering background with some technical experience across hardware, software and manufacturing.

Growth Manager (Berlin)

Salary Range: €55K – €75k

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business in the Turkish market. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.


What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth and expansion efforts in the Turkish market. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

  • You speak Turkish on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You'll hold Proxima Fusion's site development portfolio together as one program, spanning projects such as Stellaris, our manufacturing and testing infrastructure, and other site development work. Working closely with the project managers who lead each project, you'll make sure feasibility, key partner relationships and permitting strategy are handled coherently across the portfolio. Without this role, projects risk optimizing for themselves while the issues that cut across them fall through the gaps.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead Proxima Fusion's site development program across multiple parallel projects, owning feasibility, key partner and stakeholder relationships, and permitting strategy

  • Work closely with the project managers leading each site, aligning their schedules, budgets and deliverables to a single program roadmap

  • Define and run the program's decision-gate structure, from initial project approval through to final investment decision, including deliverables, readiness levels, and cost and schedule tracking

  • Represent Proxima Fusion to site owners, utility partners and other key stakeholders, building constructive, diplomatic partnerships across sites with different contexts and regulatory histories

  • Own the permitting landscape across the portfolio, including radiation protection law, environmental permitting, building permits and other approvals where relevant, and sequence parallel approval processes into one coherent strategy

  • Build organizational and infrastructure scaling plans that look beyond near-term needs, from initial capacity towards multi-GW scale

  • Report program status, risks and key decisions to senior leadership

WHO YOU ARE

  • Extensive experience leading greenfield or brownfield energy or industrial site development programs through to final investment decision, ideally on former or adjacent nuclear sites or other heavily regulated sites

  • A track record of managing multiple projects in parallel at different stages of maturity, using a structured, gate-based approach

  • Skilled at building productive relationships with incumbent site owners and utilities, and comfortable working within formal, process-driven stakeholder cultures

  • Able to pull together detailed technical requirements from engineers and specialists without needing a deep engineering background yourself

  • Fluent in German and English, which the regulatory and stakeholder landscape requires

  • Comfortable building program structure from scratch in a fast-scaling, first-of-a-kind environment

    INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Airline or Airline Catering (Europe, 100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join our fully remote, mission-driven team dedicated to pioneering sustainable inflight service management. Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.

Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.

About the role

We are on a mission to contribute to a zero-waste future by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, CO₂ emissions in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision and as a Senior Account Executive, you will be at the heart of the team that makes it possible.

You will report directly to one of the founders and work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and the broader founding team.

This is not a traditional SaaS sales role focused on high-volume transactions. Our customers are airlines, our sales cycles are complex, and our relationships often span many years.

You will be responsible for building and executing strategic sales plans, identifying and developing new opportunities, and managing enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through to contract signature.

Rather than relying solely on inbound demand, you will proactively identify target airlines, build stakeholder relationships, and develop opportunities through a structured account-based sales approach.

We are looking for someone who has already built pipeline, navigated complex airline buying processes, and personally closed significant enterprise business. You will bring both the experience and confidence to independently lead opportunities while collaborating effectively with founders and subject matter experts throughout the sales process.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. While you will mentor and coach junior sales colleagues, your primary responsibility is generating pipeline, advancing opportunities, and winning new business. If your primary motivation is managing teams rather than selling, this role is not going to be a good fit.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Enterprise Sales

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature

  • Develop and execute account-based sales strategies for airline customers

  • Build relationships with executive and senior stakeholders

  • Lead commercial negotiations and enterprise procurement processes

  • Create and maintain strategic account plans

Pipeline Generation & Market Development

  • Identify and pursue new growth opportunities with airlines globally

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities

  • Develop stakeholder maps and engagement strategies

  • Generate opportunities through industry networking, referrals, partnerships, and events

  • Continuously expand LimeFlight's presence within the airline industry

Commercial Leadership

  • Lead by example through active pipeline creation, opportunity management, and enterprise sales execution

  • Mentor and coach junior sales team members

  • Support deal reviews, account planning, and opportunity strategy

  • Share best practices for enterprise sales execution and stakeholder management

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales methodologies and commercial processes

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Founder teams

  • Coordinate internal resources throughout the sales cycle

  • Ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and communicated internally

  • Support smooth transitions from sales into implementation and customer success

  • Act as the voice of the market and customer within LimeFlight

Key competencies

  • 10+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including significant experience selling to airlines

  • Proven track record of generating pipeline through strategic account-based selling

  • Demonstrated success selling enterprise software, SaaS, or technology solutions to large airline organizations

  • Track record of personally leading and closing enterprise opportunities with a combined contract value exceeding CHF 3 million

  • Experience managing six- and seven-figure enterprise sales opportunities

  • Strong understanding of airline buying processes, stakeholder management, and enterprise procurement

  • Ability to independently drive opportunities forward within complex stakeholder environments

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • Strong commercial and business acumen

  • Collaborative mindset with a team-first attitude

  • Passion for mentoring and developing others

  • High degree of ownership, accountability, and resilience

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience selling SaaS or enterprise software solutions to airlines.

  • Existing network within the airline industry

  • Deep understanding of airline operations and organizational structures

  • Experience selling across different global markets, with the ability to adapt sales strategies and stakeholder engagement approaches to regional business cultures and buying processes.

  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior commercial team members

Language

  • Fluent English required

  • Additional languages are a plus

Expected travel needs

You should be willing to travel up to 30% of the year for customer meetings, industry conferences, trade shows, and relationship-building activities.

Given the relationship-driven nature of the airline industry, regular face-to-face interactions are an important part of the role.

Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen (45 mins)

  2. Interview with Hiring Manager (1 hour)

  3. Technical Interview (1 hour)

  4. Discussion with founder(s) and peer(s)

You’ll join a 15-person DACH sales team managing a shared base of 2,000+ existing customers, while also building new business from scratch. We need someone equally comfortable opening a brand-new account and growing one we already have — commercially sharp, technically curious, and credible with both IT stakeholders and business buyers.


You’ll get to take ownership of:

  • New-business hunting: proactively sourcing and closing new-logo accounts across Germany, Austria and Switzerland — sourcing matters as much as closing here.
  • An existing account book: owning and growing a slice of our 2,000+ customer base in DACH, spotting expansion and renewal opportunities alongside your new-business work.
  • Technically credible selling: running discovery and value conversations on data integration, EDI and supply-chain workflows, engaging both IT stakeholders and business buyers like supply chain and logistics leaders.
  • Full sales-cycle ownership: qualification through close, with accountability for your own pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and ACV.
  • Direct, no-partner-model selling: this territory is direct sales only — you own the relationship end to end, with no channel hand-offs.
  • Staying sharp with AI-assisted tooling: our sales workflow uses AI agents for company research and a lead-scoring system, so you spend your time on conversations that matter.


We’d love to meet someone with:

  • 5+ years of closing experience in B2B software sales, with a track record you can back up — we check references and verified numbers, not just a good story.

jobs.title: (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte (w/m/d) bei Dezernat Zukunft – Institut für Makrofinanzen
jobs.description:
Wer wir sind und was wir suchen

Ob die Energiewende gelingt, entscheidet sich nicht allein an Technologien, sondern an Kosten, Märkten und politischen Weichenstellungen. Genau dazu arbeitet das Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft – und um unsere Arbeit weiter zu vertiefen, suchen wir Dich. 

Das Dezernat Zukunft ist ein überparteilicher Berliner Think Tank an der Schnittstelle von Politik, Verwaltung und Forschung. Rund 30 Personen verfolgen gemeinsam das Ziel, Geld-, Finanz- und Wirtschaftspolitik neu zu denken und verständlich zu vermitteln. Geleitet von den Werten Würde, Wohlstand, Demokratie und Nachhaltigkeit suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – idealerweise ab dem 1. Januar – für unser Energy Lab eine Person als (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte. 

In dieser Position konzipierst Du Analysen und Studien zu Energiemärkten – insbesondere zum Strommarkt – und führst sie eigenständig durch. Dabei betrachtest Du Energiekosten, Investitionsbedarfe, Gesamtsystemkosten sowie die Wechselwirkungen politischer Instrumente mit diesen Größen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Fragen, wie sich Energiepolitik mit Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Bezahlbarkeit zusammendenken lässt, wie Energiekosten strategisch und gezielt gesenkt werden können, und wie das regulatorische Umfeld so ausgestaltet werden kann, dass es den Erfolg der „zweiten Hälfte der Energiewende“ und damit die Erreichung der Klimaneutralität ermöglicht.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst Energiemärkte und -preise, einschließlich Systemkosten, und koordinierst dazu Forschungsprojekte. Dabei betrachtest Du auch fiskalpolitische Auswirkungen sowie Wechselwirkungen mit dem Stromnetzausbau. 
  • Du entwickelst konkrete Politikvorschläge, Analysen und Positionen zu den oben genannten Themen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Kolleg:innen im Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft sowie den weiteren Teams der Organisation. Außerdem organisierst Du Expert:innen-Gespräche und andere inhaltliche Veranstaltungen. 
  • Du interagierst aktiv mit Vertreter:innen von Parlamenten, Regierungen, Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Medien. Unsere Arbeit funktioniert nur dann, wenn wir mit diesen Gruppen im Austausch stehen, zuhören und zusammenarbeiten.


Das bieten wir

  • Eine Vergütung in Anlehnung an den Tarifvertrag des öffentlichen Dienstes (TVöD): Eingruppierung in Entgeltgruppe E 13 – abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung – inkl. Jahressonderzahlung und 30 Urlaubstagen.
  • Aktive Unterstützung bei Deiner Weiterentwicklung – fachlich sowie in Bezug auf Kompetenzen, Netzwerke und Aufgaben. 
  • Einen Arbeitsplatz in Berlin-Mitte mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten und gemeinsam vereinbarten Kernzeiten.
  • Unbürokratische, verständnisvolle Regelungen bei kurzfristigen Care-Bedarfen; bezahlte Freistellung nach § 29 TVöD bei persönlichen Anlässen (z. B. kranke Kinder). 
  • Einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder JobRad. 
  • Und nicht zuletzt: Ein dynamisches,motiviertes Team, gemeinsame Events (z. B. Berg- oder Paddel-Ausflüge) und Arbeit, die zählt. 


Dein Profil

  • Du teilst unsere Werte und Ziele, begeisterst Dich für Energie- und Klimapolitik und brennst dafür, dass die Transformation gelingt. 
  • Du hast einen Master-Abschluss in einem relevanten Fachgebiet sowie mindestens zwei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung. Du kennst Dich in Energiemärkten – insbesondere im Strommarkt – aus, verstehst politische Instrumente und erkennst, welche Zahlen für politische Entscheidungen und ökonomische Weichenstellungen wirklich zählen. 
  • Du konzipierst und erstellst eigene Analysen – quantitativ wie textlich – selbstständig und gründlich. Du hast bereits erfolgreich Forschungsprojekte umgesetzt und Ergebnisse sowie politische Handlungsempfehlungen prägnant kommuniziert. Du bist Dir bewusst, dass unsere Analysen und Vorschläge in der Öffentlichkeit intensiv geprüft werden, und arbeitest entsprechend gewissenhaft und bist bereit, als Eigentümer:in für Deine Projekte einzustehen.
  • Du kommunizierst sehr gut in deutscher und englischer Sprache und verfasst in beiden Sprachen anspruchsvolle, gut verständliche Texte.
  • Du hast fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in der praktischen Anwendung gängiger KI-Programme. 
  • Du willst den Dingen auf den Grund gehen und jeden Tag dazulernen. Noch wichtiger als mitgebrachtes Wissen ist für uns die Fähigkeit, es zu erweitern und Meinungen zu ändern. 
  • Du arbeitest gern im Team, hörst zu und unterstützt und förderst Deine Kolleg:innen.
Die perfekte Kandidat:in erfüllt nicht immer jede Anforderung. Wenn Du glaubst, dass Du zu uns passt – bewirb Dich gern trotzdem und sag uns, warum.


Beschäftigungsbeginn & Vertragsbedingungen

  • Beginn: Von uns aus so schnell wie möglich. Im Anschluss an das Bewerbungsverfahren rechnen wir mit einem Start im Januar 2027. Das genaue Startdatum ist verhandelbar. 
  • Umfang: 32–39 Stunden/Woche (flexibel je nach Deiner Verfügbarkeit). 
  • Befristung: zunächst 1 Jahr (Entfristung nach zwei Jahren angestrebt).


Bewerbungsverfahren

Bitte bewirb Dich online mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Anschreiben, das Deine Eignung entlang der oben genannten Kriterien zeigt. Bitte teile uns auch mit, wie Du auf die Stelle aufmerksam geworden bist und welche Wochenarbeitszeit Du bevorzugen würdest. 

Bewerbungsfrist: 08. November 2026

Das Bewerbungsverfahren besteht aus drei Runden: im ersten Schritt einem Assessment-Test, der aus einer schriftlichen Aufgabe besteht und ca. 1-2 Stunden Arbeitszeit beansprucht; anschließend ein längeres Gespräch bei uns vor Ort im Büro und einem abschließenden Gespräch mit unserem Head of Energy Lab – Janek Steitz.

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und möchten die Diversität unseres Teams fördern. Bewerbungen sind willkommen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, kultureller oder sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.


Kontakt / Rückfragen

Du findest die Rolle spannend, weißt aber nicht, ob sie etwas für Dich ist oder ob Du gut ins Dezernat und zu den Anforderungen passen würdest? Sprich mit uns! Hierfür kannst Du Felix Heilmann – Programmleitung Energiepolitik – direkt per E-Mail kontaktieren Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse im beruflichen Alltag

  • Eine ausgereifte Produktivinfrastruktur im Einsatz bei Industriekunden

jobs.title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
jobs.description:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié
